status: All 245 original compound records retained, with additive v0.41 reductions. Current open tasks are in the selected leaf register; no whole scope is silently closed by a subclaim.
count_policy: Historical compound categories are navigation; current sufficient leaves retain exact coupled contracts and are not completion percentages.
completed_previous_frontier: NTL1–NTL17: full original neatU is reconstructed for every QData, arbitrary integral tau0 and every original compact-open level K. The proof uses the fixed odd auxiliary prime stored in HidaSetting, its actual unramified place, bounded integral unitary powers and principal congruence torsion-freeness. Every section fallback, level join and same-coordinate identity is checked; no ell>n or integral-type premise is added.

OTW1–OTW13: full original TThetaEx is reconstructed using the actual artOf and complete coefficient ring. Finite characters at every adic precision kill the actual Artin kernel; separatedness produces one full-ring character, and the inverse cyclotomic adjustment gives the original product-torus theta. This one theta is fixed before every K; full neatU supplies its IsWt freeness. The original HdEx record is assembled after the complete original TypeForAlt is supplied, using inherited CAP17 IsRes. TypeForAlt itself remains open.

RTG1–RTG25: prescribed-field coefficient extension, original split class representatives, self-dual lattice square law and finite residue PhiIs are reconstructed. Every Pins field is assembled from the exact CoversAt input. The class-sum finite transfer gives phase-correct OneMapOverL with common lambda,z before O; the actual good projector gives RatG and both-level LiftTestB. Exact MLat follows from the original LatFull field. Higher covers, class-sum existence/uniqueness, PointIdentCore, base ClassSumsSpan and geometric LatFull production remain explicit upstream suppliers.

HLP1–HLP32: original HeckeLift0, all-index commutation, HeckeStd0 and HeckeIntTw are reconstructed from their original complex/form inputs. Every maximal ideal is an actual residual eigenspace class; the literal projected MtSub is finite free and localizes to the exact part. Psi, range, projection error, spans, faithful ActEx/ActHK, original MjLat relation quotient and complete nonempty_spec are supplied on their full original antecedents. One coefficient compositum preserves all four requirements. Actual F3/F4, complex Hecke/no-Jordan and arithmetic character suppliers remain open.

There are 87 new and 2209 cumulative human proof claims. The whole selected open-leaf register remains 33=22C+9B+2D: 26 shared by RH and unrestricted Dirichlet GRH, with 7 additional GRH-only leaves. Completed internal producers reduce those obligations without declaring a compound leaf complete.
next_local_priority: Construct the adjoining simultaneous principal framed points and test-ring dictionary. The next bounded target is allTest_of_secBaseChange: represent FrPt by the Lie-eigenframe bundles and theta-section frame line, use the full n=1 SecBaseChangeSt on every nonflat coefficient base change, and prove finite-generated subalgebra descent with the exact TRing/FromTest transport. Continue higher CoversAt, all-tuple class sums and uniqueness with original phase rescalings, one PointIdentCore with common lambda,z, base ClassSumsSpan, Gaussian/reproduction, short-rule dictionaries and ramified jets, retaining both-level, coefficient-field, Fits and eta agreements.

UCE now proves all ordinary local/curve/coefficient consumers and the exact implication to FinA/AutB/LemW, including arbitrary entry maps and every original outer-corner extension. At this pin the alternative upstream route gives GdEndAlt; its additional local/descent fields must be matched to the actual original points, so no name-only GdEndAlt-to-GdEnd identification is allowed. precision_notes: The source Lean proof is assumed fully checked and correct, as requested. A D item concerns our human source understanding only.
The audit is minimal at specified sufficient interfaces, not a proof of mathematical minimality and not an exhaustive Lean dependency graph.

The same actual host, field, family, maps, lattices, metrics, coefficient rings and quantifier order must be retained; partial producer lists and semantic work-sharing links are not sufficient AND rules.
Case III is vacuous only for targets of power-of-two order, including the principal target. Counts I, II and V remain nonempty even for RH.
For the principal target, CountI uses Q(sqrt(-7)); CountV has a distinct Gaussian/quartic field endpoint. Shared rank-three methods do not identify the two.
An integral positive-part AQ bound must use a fixed positive target family and fixed stretch before eta and the arbitrarily late window; no arithmetic producer is supplied.

All 245 inherited targets are retained with complete scope dispositions. Their 107 groups and A/B/C/D record counts are navigation statistics, not independent-obligation counts or completion percentages.
Original claim/source fields and old mathematical edges are preserved. Additive scope updates do not retroactively remove conditional hypotheses.
No Lean build or kernel replay is performed. Draft-mode TeX checks syntax and cross-references and does not certify visual layout. No new PDF is generated.
